subject.title: fix(discord): retry stale preview cleanup after final delivery

question: Should failed preview deletion retain the message ID as the permanent behavior of the shipped `clearFinalizableDraftMessage` plugin SDK helper?
rationale: The implementation is correct and repairs shipped behavior, but it intentionally changes an exported helper's observable failure contract for external channel plugins.

options.title: Approve Retained Ownership
options.body: Make successful deletion the canonical ownership-clear boundary and merge this focused fix.

options.title: Keep Existing SDK Semantics
options.body: Preserve consume-before-delete for external callers and implement retained ownership inside Discord instead.

recommendation.title: Approve Retained Ownership
recommendation.body: Make successful deletion the canonical ownership-clear boundary and merge this focused fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Shared lifecycle authorship and co-authorship of the Discord regression provenance make this the strongest available decision owner.
